title: Preservation under iteration
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a type, let $g:\alpha\to\alpha$, and let $I$ be a property of elements of $\alpha$. Suppose $I(s)$ implies $I(g(s))$ for every $s$. Then, for every natural number $n$, if $I(s)$ holds, it also holds for the result of applying $g$ to $s$ exactly $n$ times.
